svg.title: .SYSTEMX — SYSTEM MAP 1 / ARCHITECTURE
svg.desc: The portable root keeps objective, plan, canonical tasks and focus. Named .SYSTEMXP children keep independent records under one outer toolchain.
svg.text: One portable root, explicit child scopes, one canonical task ledger
Separate context, tasks, decisions and memory
One outer .SYSTEMX installation; child records are selected by name.
A chat or current directory does not silently select a child scope.
